summary: The mission-cancellation and broken-gate integration tests run their isolated daemon at the fastest supported reconcile pass cap (600 a minute), as the reconcile unit tests do, instead of waiting out the default 30 a minute.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.
